sections.heading: Business
sections.markdown: Basic Materials / Gold · Indonesia. PT Antam (Persero) Tbk operates as a diversified metals and mining company in Indonesia. The company operates through three segments: Nickel, Precious Metals and Refinery, and Bauxite and Alumina. The company is involved in the exploration, excavation, processing, and marketing of alumina, nickel ore, ferronickel, gold, silver, bauxite, and coal. It also engages in construction, trading, industry, mining, agriculture, printing, and ground transportation businesses; and provision of industrial area management…
